findings.statement: Every value and page cited in electric_technology.py _SCREENING_BRACKETS and in the lee2021 set was found on the original pages; no transcription error was found.

Complete battery+motor+inverter sets with stated power bases exist in three held sources: Lee 2021 (registered in code), Kwak 2018 and Pavlov Rachov 2013 (not registered). Casalino 2019 and Solda-Lentini 2008 give battery data but only combined drive-plus-pump values on electrical-input basis; Park 2023 gives motor and inverter values with unstated basis and no independent battery; SP-8107 gives only turbine-driven turbopump assembly data.

repository_screening_v1 (the default set) has inverter density 15 kW/kg below every held value (26.64-60) and inverter efficiency 0.96 above every held value (0.80-0.85); its constant discharge efficiency 0.95 corresponds to the held correlation only near 785 s. Confirmed against the code's own bracket positions.

Source-internal conflicts recorded, not corrected: Casalino 2019 Set A overall efficiency 0.64 (text p.5) vs 0.68 (Table 1 p.6); Kwak 2018 D-cell energy density 198.5 (Table 2) vs 198 Wh/kg (Table 3).

MDO pump_specific_mass (2.5 kW/kg, not part of a technology set) lies below every held pump-only electric-pump value (Kwak 15 and 20 kW/kg; Rachov 22 kW/kg) and below operational turbopump assemblies in SP-8107 Table I (3.65-35.5 kW/kg); the bases differ (pump only, turbopump assembly, combined drive plus pump), so no value is directly transferable.

unblock.note: Three complete held sets are page-verified (Lee 2021, Kwak 2018, Pavlov Rachov 2013); choosing the default and registering additional sets is an owner/engineering decision. The current default repository_screening_v1 lies outside held evidence (gap G4). No code was changed.
